notes: Persistent characters, Dark Helm, and Obsidian Storm Tiger quest.
details: Password-protected characters restore saved skills, XP, position, inventory and equipped items.
Host saves player progress periodically and at disconnect; bank records persist.
Dark Helm is Very Rare and drops from monsters rather than being sold.
Obsidian Storm Tiger is awarded from Lyra Stormwarden quest, not the shop.
Requires the multiplayer host and players to use compatible v1.0.4 files.
